notes.title: A lots of fixes
notes.notes:
Hi there,
I fixed a lot of things in the game for this update, let's see:
-able to replay a level if you not reached the 3 stars
-not play level 100 over and over, if you didn't have enought stars
-if you replay a level, you can go directly to the level selection screen
-the level selection positioning to the page, where you can start the next level
-french language added (the game check your system's lang)
-better menu arts
-moving menu items
-no fake sound effects if you can't click on the donut
-faster candy movement
